english.note: Use 針 as the all-purpose everyday word for a sewing, craft, acupuncture, or injection needle.

examples.english: This needle is very fine, just right for sewing clothes.
examples.traditional: 呢支針好幼，縫衫啱啱好。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zi1 zam1 hou2 jau3 fung4 saam1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sewing or knitting stitch, and it is also used when counting surgical stitches, as in 縫幾針.

examples.english: The nurse says they can remove one stitch from my back tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 姑娘話聽日可以拆我背脊嗰一針喇。
examples.jyutping: gu1 noeng4 waa6 ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 caak3 ngo5 bui3 zek3 go2 jat1 zam1 laa3

english.note: Use this in the medical context for a vaccination or injection, as in “a tetanus shot.”

examples.english: Remember to get your shot tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ting1 jat6 gei3 zyu6 heoi3 daa2 zam1 aa3
